notes.title: New (free) game in development.
notes.content:
Once again I'm using this game to promote others.

This time it's "Sayonara Sigil Sentry", a small boss rush in which you'll have to draw a series of magic runes to defeat giant monsters. It's kind of like playing a bulelt hell and "connect the dots" at the saem time. Despite the similar artstyle, this is a more action-oriented experience, with a much clearer (and way more over-the-top) lore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/7a80097e818feac438ace79062057cf341f692b2.png[/img]

S3 will be available for free, and it comes with a small bonus for longtime fans: if the game detects the savefiles of my previous Steam games (plus several free games from my Itch.io page), it will unlock alternate color palettes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/cb638aa78bf7d96ba220e0181c0682cb7745569c.png[/img]

(And yeah, there will be a Captain Poweryarn cameo.)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576590/Sayonara_Sigil_Sentry/

notes.title: Quick bugfix

notes.title: New horror game in development (with demo)
notes.content:
I’m once again using this game to announce others since it’s the one that seems to get more attention. Probably because the monsters look cool and it’s cheap. But anyways, on to the new mess:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/9c5a2ca2022c9a84bd2505b5fe47163d16f623ba.jpg[/img]
Pseudo-Haunting is my first foray into classic survival horror. It’s got all the basics: limited supplies, fixed camera angles (built with modern controls in mind), optional tank controls, [strike]crappy [/strike]old-school 3D models and documents with important lore laying on the floor. Yes, there’s a story this time around.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/2b854b3b74a14e4ddc483258bd79d386b22f2956.png[/img]
However, the game has a major twist in regards to the combat: to fight off the ghost-bug-things, you will rip off your own spirit of your body. It’s similar to how moving the parasite works in this game, but much more useful. And it’s not limited to combat, you will also be using it to solve puzzles and explore a glitched haunted house.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/50f32a1087a4e85dd6889cbc3b0a03938ed6dd14.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/bd334438c231a35e8e629b3daffc9e3e6f745773.png[/img]
The demo is available now, hope you enjoy the confusion:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648260/PseudoHaunting

notes.title: New horror roguelike in development (with demo)
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325040/DETUNED/
Welcome to “DETUNED”, an anti-rhythm hidden object game where you try to survive a randomly generated “song”. While “Me and My Eldritch Parasite” is more of a roguelite, this project is a full-on roguelike, with permadeath and a shop system.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/c8068274afb6f7302534b4d313262ea128f7d213.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/c8068274afb6f7302534b4d313262ea128f7d213.gif[/img][/url]
Speaking of the shop system, if “DETUNED” detects that you have the “Me and My Eldritch Parasite” save files, a bonus item will be unlocked. This works by looking for MAMEP’s save folder, so you’ll probably need to have played the tutorial or changed the settings for it to work, but it will detect any version of the game (Steam, Itch.io or Gamejolt).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/148fc81a7a819988d32be91e950e450cd07bec4a.png[/img]

notes.title: Fixed ending bug + minor updates
notes.content:
The achievements update introduced an error that caused the game to lock the player on ending 1. This was caused by a misplaced line of code and has been fixed.
Additionally, a few minor improvements have been added:
-Changed pause menu text color when selected so it's easier to read.
-Decreased one of the final bosses' attack chance.

notes.title: In-game achievements update
notes.content:
I’ve been working on adding a custom achievement system for future projects and decided to test it with this good old abominatio… err,game. I settled on in-game achievements over Steam ones so the feature remains avalaible to the plenty of (2 or 3) people that buy the Itch.io or Gamejolt versions of “Me and my Eldritch Parasite”. This update also adds a screen where you can view the achievement’s conditions and your current progress.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357633/8afc4370e808050af3e85ae890c43d1582481e0b.png[/img]
The requirements for the achievements do not check for progress before the update (mostly because a system to check for that kinda didn’t exist in the old version), so returning players will have to meet the Eternal Residence’s lovely hosts once again. 

Additionally, this update adds a few minor changes:
[list]
[*] Reworked an animation in the bedroom area that caused slight flashing lights on larger screens.
[*] “Go to sleep” option in the bedroom area takes you to the title screen instead of closing the game.
[/list]

That sound all, but, since I got you attention, have a self-promotion for the remake of and old game with a similar artstyle to “Me and my Eldritch Parasite”, but a more linear and streamlined gameplay (sort of):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2050150/Siphonopolis/

notes.title: The soundtrack has been released
notes.content: The soundtrack from [i]Me and My Eldritch Parasite[/i] (if you can call it that) is out now.

notes.title: Quality-of-life updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game displays the current floor number when using a door.
[*] Tutorial text changed to highlight that the parasite is the player's hitbox.
[*] Enemies ignore you for a brief amount of time when using a door.
[*] Losing a normal level no longer resets the adquired tools.
[*] "Main menu" buton removed from pause menu to prevent "going to main menu and restarting level" exploit.
[/list]
